title: Union of India v. Azadi Bachao Andolan

content.caseIdentity: Union of India v. Azadi Bachao Andolan, (2004) 10 SCC 1
content.facts: The Court considered treaty benefits, circulars and tax avoidance arguments.
questionsBeforeCourt: How should a valid tax treaty and administrative circular operate?
content.ratioDecidendi: A treaty and valid administrative practice must be respected unless displaced by law; legitimate tax planning is not automatically evasion.
content.holding: The Court upheld the challenged treaty approach in the circumstances.
content.relevance: Use for statutory interpretation, treaties and tax planning.
